name: Let's Enhance
description_en:
Let’s Enhance is an online AI image enhancement and upscaling service. Users upload photos, choose an enhancement goal/mode and process individual images or batches before downloading higher-resolution or corrected output. The current homepage advertises 20 images at once and up to 512 megapixels, but actual input/output limits depend on the plan and operation.

It fits preparing images for web, print or visual content workflows when the source quality is insufficient. AI-generated detail must be inspected rather than treated as recovered historical fact or a guaranteed print result. Signup credits are finite, paid credits/rollover/storage have conditions, and Claid.ai/API/business offers must be distinguished from the consumer enhancement account.
description_zh:
Let’s Enhance是在线AI图像增强及放大服务，上传照片后选择目标/模式，单张或批量处理，再下载更高分辨率或修正输出。当前首页宣传一次20张及最多512兆像素，实际输入/输出仍取决于套餐和操作。

它适合原图质量不足的网页、印刷及视觉内容准备。AI生成细节需检查，不能当作恢复的历史事实或保证印刷结果。注册点数有限，付费点数、结转及存储有条件，Claid.ai/API/商业方案应与消费者增强账户区分。

sections.title_en: Enhance the image without treating generated detail as evidence
sections.title_zh: 增强图像但不把生成细节当证据
sections.en:
The [current homepage](https://letsenhance.io/) offers enhancement, upscaling, sharpening and old-photo repair. It says Prime is the default for many images, Gentle is suited to small text/fine detail, and Old Photo can repair damage before further processing. It separately routes ecommerce automation to Claid.ai and links API products; do not assume every business feature is included in a personal plan.

Editorial example: enlarge an approved illustration for a poster or improve a product photo for a listing. Inspect identity, product geometry, lettering, texture and color against the source. Increasing pixel dimensions or a DPI tag does not prove authentic recovered detail or accurate physical print size. Avoid using an aesthetically plausible reconstruction as documentary evidence.
sections.zh:
[当前首页](https://letsenhance.io/)提供增强、放大、锐化及旧照修复，称Prime为多数图默认，Gentle适合小字/精细细节，Old Photo可先修损伤再处理。电商自动化另指向Claid.ai，并链接API产品，不能假定个人方案含全部商业功能。

编辑示例：把获批插画放大做海报，或改善商品页照片；应对照原图检查身份、几何、文字、纹理及颜色。增加像素或DPI标签不证明恢复了真实细节，也不自动确定准确印刷尺寸，不能把看似合理的重建当文献证据。

sections.title_en: Upload, choose the goal and compare the actual output
sections.title_zh: 上传、选目标并比较实际输出
sections.en:
The current three-step workflow accepts JPG, PNG and WebP, asks for upscale/enhance/sharpen, then downloads full-resolution output. Check the plan-specific input dimensions and operation before uploading. Choose an appropriate mode, inspect a representative output at actual size and compare fine details before a larger batch. Paid plans remove the watermark; the pricing FAQ says previously enhanced free-credit images can be downloaded again without it after buying an eligible plan/bundle.

The [how-to page](https://letsenhance.io/how-to-use) describes batch processing up to 20 images, size selection, presets and1xenhancement, but names older algorithms such as Balanced Enhance and Photo2.0. Those historical controls should not be assumed to match the current Prime/Gentle interface. Preserve originals and exported results; no upload, processing, re-download or print proof was run here.
sections.zh:
当前三步流程接受JPG、PNG及WebP，选择放大/增强/锐化，再下载全分辨率输出。上传前检查套餐输入尺寸及具体操作，选合适模式，按实际尺寸比较代表结果及细节后再跑大批。付费去水印；价格FAQ表示购买符合条件的方案/包后，原先免费点处理的图也可重新下载无水印版。

[操作页](https://letsenhance.io/how-to-use)介绍最多20张批处理、尺寸、预设及1倍增强，但使用Balanced Enhance、Photo2.0等旧算法名，不能假定与当前Prime/Gentle控件一致。应保留原图及导出，本文未上传、处理、重下载或印刷校样。

sections.title_en: Finite signup credits and operation-specific limits
sections.title_zh: 有限注册点数与逐操作限制
sections.en:
The [pricing page](https://letsenhance.io/pricing) gives 10 signup credits without a card, watermarked output, input up to 24 MP/50 MB and upscaling up to 8 MP in the Free card. This is a finite evaluation allowance, not a sustained free monthly plan. Paid Starter/Pro/Max cards list 100/300/500 credits per month, output up to 256/350/512 MP and input up to 64 MP/50 MB. Starter lists three months of storage, Pro/Max six; “unlimited storage” describes capacity within a retention period, not indefinite archival.

The page’s generic FAQ instead says all inputs up to 64 MP and personal output up to 256 MP/business 500 MP. That conflicts with Free/Pro/Max cards and is retained as an unresolved documentation mismatch. Background removal separately caps both input/output at 16 MP. Verify the actual account and operation rather than applying the highest marketing limit to every job. A file can be under 50 MB yet exceed the megapixel limit.
sections.zh:
[价格页](https://letsenhance.io/pricing)提供无需信用卡的10个注册点，Free卡片为有水印、输入最多24MP/50MB、输出最多8MP，是有限评估额度，不是持续免费月方案。付费Starter/Pro/Max分别每月100/300/500点，输出最多256/350/512MP，输入最多64MP/50MB。Starter存储3个月、Pro/Max6个月，“无限存储”指期限内容量，不是永久档案。

同页通用FAQ却说所有输入最多64MP、个人输出256MP/商业500MP，与Free/Pro/Max卡片冲突，本文保留未解决差异。去背景又独立限制输入/输出16MP。应按真实账户及操作核查，不能把最高宣传限额应用所有任务；文件低于50MB也可能超像素限制。

sections.title_en: Allowance, rollover cap and cancellation all affect cost
sections.title_zh: 额度、结转上限及取消共同影响成本
sections.en:
The read cards display Starter $9/month billed annually or $12 monthly, Pro $24 or $32 and Max $34 or $45. Dollar currency, taxes, final annual totals and renewal should be confirmed at checkout. One processed image equals one credit under the pricing description; additional operations or separate generative/video services were not tested. Pay-as-you-go bundles and business plans exist, but their current numeric prices were not exposed in the read default view.

Personal unused credits roll over up to six times the monthly allowance:600/1,800/3,000. Business allowances 1,000/2,500/5,000 do not roll over according to the FAQ. Changing a plan changes the cap. Canceling preserves the paid period but loses remaining credits and benefits at its end; subscriptions auto-renew on the chosen billing cycle. A failed card payment can therefore affect stored credits. Do not assume purchased bundle expiry or personal rollover rules apply to all plans.
sections.zh:
实读卡片显示Starter年付折合每月$9或月付$12，Pro为$24/$32，Max为$34/$45。美元符号对应币种、税费、最终年额及续费需结账确认。价格描述处理1图耗1点，附加操作或独立生成/视频服务未测。网站有随用随付包及商业方案，但实读默认视图未显示当前数值价。

个人未用点最多结转6倍月额度，即600/1,800/3,000；FAQ表示商业1,000/2,500/5,000额度不结转。换套餐会改变上限，取消保留已付账期，但结束时丢失剩余点和权益。按所选账期自动续费，因此银行卡支付失败也可能影响存点。不能把包的失效或个人结转规则推及全部方案。

sections.title_en: A hosted processor with content and organization terms
sections.title_zh: 有内容及组织条款的托管处理服务
sections.en:
The [March 1,2024 terms](https://letsenhance.io/terms) grant limited service access and no source-code rights while preserving third-party open-source component licenses. Uploaded content remains with the user/licensors, but the provider receives a broad license for service operation and de-identified improvement/business analysis; deletion uses reasonable efforts and cached references may persist. An organization-paid or organization-email account can be treated as belonging to that organization. This is not a universal no-retention/no-training assurance.

Hosted users are also directed to a Master Services Agreement that can prevail, and text-to-image has separate terms. Those full agreements and detailed privacy/subprocessor settings were not reviewed. Obtain the appropriate scope before processing sensitive client or identifiable-photo material. The user remains responsible for upload/output rights and independent inspection; no commercial clearance, private-data handling or output-fidelity test is claimed.
sections.zh:
[2024年3月1日条款](https://letsenhance.io/terms)授予有限服务访问、不提供源码权，同时保留第三方开源组件许可。上传内容归用户/许可人，但提供方获广泛运营及去标识改善/业务分析许可；删除仅作合理努力，缓存引用可能仍在。组织付款或组织邮箱账户可被视为属于组织，不能理解为统一零保留/不训练保证。

托管用户还被要求适用优先的Master Services Agreement，文生图另有条款；这些完整协议及详细隐私/子处理方设置未审查。处理敏感客户或可识别照片前需取得适当范围。用户仍负责上传/输出权利及独立检查，本文不声称商用清权、私有数据处理或保真测试已完成。
